feature: Clinical course: node-negative R0 resection with early recurrence
test_name: EUS-guided core needle biopsy of the pancreatic body mass with histologic confirmation and tissue banked for downstream molecular and IHC work
tissue_type: fresh core biopsy of the recurrent lesion
rationale: Everything known about this tumor comes from a resection specimen taken before four more cycles of FOLFIRINOX, and the new mass has not been sampled, so its histology is presumed rather than established. One EUS-guided pass supplies the tissue that the CLDN18.2 re-stain, the DNA and RNA sequencing, and most tissue-gated trial screens all draw on. Skipping it means treating a radiographic diagnosis with a target call that may no longer hold.
turnaround_estimate: 1-2 weeks to schedule and report histology
tissue_required_estimate: EUS-guided core biopsy; request at least three cores so one goes to a paraffin block for IHC and the rest to molecular
decision_gated: Confirms the mass is recurrent PDAC and supplies tissue for every tissue-gated CLDN18.2 program (ASP2138 NCT05365581, CT041 NCT04404595).
notes: Likely vascular invasion is a route question rather than an absolute barrier; EUS from the stomach or duodenum usually avoids intervening vessels where a percutaneous route cannot. If the interventional team judges the lesion unsafe to sample, the plasma ctDNA row is the fallback and should be ordered in parallel rather than after.

test_name: Comprehensive tumor NGS on recurrent-lesion tissue, DNA plus RNA, reporting codon-level KRAS genotype, TP53, homologous-recombination genes, fusions, MSI and TMB
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion FFPE core biopsy; the December 2025 resection block is the fallback
rationale: G12R is not touched by the G12C-selective drugs (sotorasib, adagrasib) or by G12D-selective agents, so the codon-level call is what separates a pan-RAS(ON) route such as daraxonrasib from drugs that cannot work here; RASolute 302 (NCT06625320) asks for documented RAS status at codon 12, 13, or 61. Re-sequencing the recurrence also tests whether the driver persisted through ten cycles of FOLFIRINOX and catches anything acquired under that pressure. A DNA-only panel leaves fusion status unestablished rather than negative, which is why RNA should ride along.
tissue_required_estimate: FFPE block or 10-15 unstained slides from the recurrent-lesion biopsy; archival resection block acceptable if the biopsy fails
decision_gated: Pan-RAS(ON) trials for daraxonrasib (NCT06625320, NCT07491445) and rezatapopt via PYNNACLE (NCT04585750).

providers.name: Caris Life Sciences
providers.assay_brand: MI Cancer Seek (whole exome plus whole transcriptome)
providers.notes: Whole exome plus whole transcriptome in one order covers the codon-level KRAS call, HR genes, and RNA fusions without a second send-out.

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.notes: FoundationOne CDx is the report format most sponsors accept without re-testing; DNA only, so fusion coverage is narrower.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.address: 600 West Chicago Avenue, Suite 510, Chicago, IL 60654

notes: Pull the December 2025 report first. If that panel already covered fusions, BRAF, and the HR genes, the new sequencing is about the recurrence rather than about filling gaps in the original.

test_name: Plasma ctDNA comprehensive panel reporting KRAS codon 12 genotype and TP53 Y220C with variant allele fractions
tissue_type: 10-20 mL peripheral blood in Streck or equivalent tubes
rationale: If the lesion turns out to be unsafe to biopsy, plasma is the only route to a current genotype, and it answers within about a week rather than a month. Several mutant-KRAS vaccine protocols in this space use ctDNA positivity as an entry criterion (ELI-002 7P, NCT05726864 phase 1, NCT07671339), so the result can gate access rather than merely inform it. A negative plasma result in a low-shedding pancreatic lesion does not overturn the tissue findings, which is the main way this assay is misread.
tissue_required_estimate: 10-20 mL whole blood; no tissue and no procedure
decision_gated: Genotype for daraxonrasib and rezatapopt when tissue is not obtainable; ctDNA-positivity entry criterion for ELI-002 7P protocols.

providers.name: Guardant Health
providers.notes: FDA-approved liquid CDx, high volume in gastrointestinal cancers, and the fastest routine turnaround of the four.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.address: 600 West Chicago Avenue, Suite 510, Chicago, IL 60654

notes: Order alongside the biopsy rather than after it. Pancreatic body lesions shed variably and a paired tissue plus plasma result is more interpretable than either alone.

feature: CLDN18.2 expression, moderate-to-strong (2+/3+) in 60% of tumor cells
test_name: CLDN18.2 IHC by the VENTANA CLDN18 (43-14A) RxDx assay, reporting percent of viable tumor cells with moderate-to-strong (2+/3+) membranous staining
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion biopsy preferred; December 2025 resection block acceptable
rationale: The existing 60% 2+/3+ result was produced by an assay the report does not name, and the >=75% cutoff that defines zolbetuximab eligibility in SPOTLIGHT and GLOW is specific to the 43-14A companion assay, so an unnamed clone cannot be scored against it. Re-staining with the FDA assay puts the number on the scale that every threshold conversation uses, including the sponsor assays for ASP2138 (NCT05365581) and CT041 (NCT04404595), which require central or protocol-specified IHC. Without it the whole CLDN18.2 strategy rests on a percentage that cannot be compared to any published threshold.
turnaround_estimate: 2-5 days once tissue is in the lab
tissue_required_estimate: FFPE block, or one H&E plus 2-3 positively charged unstained slides at 4-5 microns with more than 100 viable tumor cells
decision_gated: Off-label zolbetuximab and every CLDN18.2 trial that scores against the 43-14A assay (ASP2138 NCT05365581, CT041 NCT04404595).

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
providers.assay_brand: Claudin 18 FDA (VYLOY), VENTANA CLDN18 (43-14A) RxDx Assay
providers.notes: Runs the FDA RxDx assay as a catalogued test with a 2-day global turnaround and 24-hour tech-only option; the fastest of the three verified US options.

providers.name: Mayo Clinic Laboratories
providers.notes: Semi-quantitative 43-14A IHC, manual; useful as a second read or when the treating center already routes to Mayo.

notes: The 43-14A assay is not the only scoring convention in play. Trial sponsors name their own assay and cutoff, and satri-cel enrolled at >=2+ intensity in >=40% of tumor cells, which this case clears on the primary. Ask the protocol which assay it accepts before assuming a re-stain satisfies it.

feature: CLDN18.2 expression, moderate-to-strong (2+/3+) in 60% of tumor cells
test_name: Paired CLDN18.2 IHC on the recurrent-lesion biopsy and the December 2025 resection block, stained and scored side by side in one laboratory
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion biopsy plus archival resection block
rationale: CLDN18.2 expression is discordant between primary and metastatic lesions in a substantial minority of gastric cases (PMID 40200874), and loss of expression under zolbetuximab treatment has been documented in a reported case (PMID 41854734), so a stain from a pre-adjuvant resection is weak evidence about a lesion that emerged after ten cycles of chemotherapy. Running both specimens in the same laboratory in the same batch is what separates real biological change from inter-laboratory scoring drift. If only the recurrence is stained and comes back lower, there will be no way to tell which of the two explanations applies.
turnaround_estimate: 2-5 days once both specimens are in the same lab
tissue_required_estimate: unstained slides from both blocks; request the December 2025 resection block from the operating hospital early, since retrieval is often the slow step
decision_gated: Whether the archival 60% result can stand in for current expression when a CLDN18.2 trial requires contemporaneous tissue.

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
providers.assay_brand: Claudin 18 FDA (VYLOY), VENTANA CLDN18 (43-14A) RxDx Assay
providers.notes: Single-laboratory batch of both specimens is the point of this row; NeoGenomics accepts outside blocks and runs the FDA assay routinely.

notes: Concordance data in pancreatic adenocarcinoma specifically is thinner than in gastric cancer; a 2025 preprint comparing biopsy, resection, and recurrent PDAC specimens exists but has not been peer reviewed, so it is not cited as a reference here.

feature: Homologous recombination deficiency / BRCA1 / BRCA2 pathogenic variant (germline and somatic)
test_name: Dedicated germline multigene panel on blood or saliva covering BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, CDKN2A, STK11 and the mismatch-repair genes
rationale: The 'no incidental germline findings' line came off a tumor NGS report, which is not built for germline sensitivity, misses large rearrangements, and does not state which homologous-recombination genes were covered. NCCN recommends germline testing for every patient with pancreatic adenocarcinoma, and a pathogenic BRCA1/2 or PALB2 variant puts an approved PARP-inhibitor maintenance strategy on the table in this tumor type (POLO, PMID 31157963 and PMID 35834777) as well as arguing for keeping platinum in the sequence. It is a blood draw with no procedure attached, so it should go out now rather than wait on tissue.
tissue_required_estimate: 5-10 mL whole blood in EDTA, or a saliva kit
decision_gated: PARP-inhibitor maintenance (olaparib) eligibility, platinum re-challenge weighting, and family testing.

providers.name: Myriad Genetics
providers.address: 322 North 2200 West, Salt Lake City, UT 84116
providers.assay_brand: MyRisk Hereditary Cancer with BRACAnalysis CDx
providers.notes: BRACAnalysis CDx is the companion diagnostic named in the olaparib pancreatic label, so a Myriad result needs no confirmatory re-test if PARP maintenance comes into play.

notes: The POLO label describes maintenance in disease that has not progressed on at least 16 weeks of first-line platinum, and recurrence four months after adjuvant FOLFIRINOX does not map cleanly onto that. The germline result still governs later-line PARP use, platinum sequencing, and relatives' screening, so read it carefully rather than skip it.

test_name: TP53 p.Y220C confirmation on a CLIA-certified NGS test (tumor tissue or plasma) reporting the variant at codon level with variant allele fraction
rationale: PYNNACLE (NCT04585750) states only that the tumor must carry a TP53 Y220C mutation, but the companion rezatapopt protocols spell out what counts: CLIA-certified local testing with variant allele fraction above 2% (NCT06616636), and tissue-based or liquid-biopsy NGS both acceptable (NCT07372625). The December 2025 tissue result probably satisfies this on its face; what the sponsor will want confirmed is that the variant is still present in current disease. Turning up at screening with only a pre-adjuvant report risks a re-test delay at best.
turnaround_estimate: immediate if the December 2025 report is retrieved and acceptable; 1-3 weeks on new tissue or plasma sequencing
tissue_required_estimate: no new specimen if the existing CLIA report is accepted; otherwise rides on the recurrence NGS or the plasma ctDNA draw

providers.name: Foundation Medicine
providers.notes: FoundationOne CDx and FoundationOne Liquid CDx reports are accepted at face value by most sponsors, which is the whole point of this row.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.address: 600 West Chicago Avenue, Suite 510, Chicago, IL 60654

providers.name: Caris Life Sciences
providers.assay_brand: MI Cancer Seek (whole exome plus whole transcriptome)

notes: Confirm with the site whether the December 2025 report satisfies screening before ordering anything new. The cheapest version of this row is a phone call and a PDF.

feature: Clinical course: node-negative R0 resection with early recurrence
test_name: Graded neurologic examination for peripheral sensory neuropathy (CTCAE v5) with a patient-reported instrument (EORTC QLQ-CIPN20) at baseline
rationale: Ten total cycles of FOLFIRINOX is a large cumulative oxaliplatin exposure and no neuropathy grade appears anywhere in the record, yet most trial protocols exclude grade 2 or higher peripheral neuropathy and every platinum or taxane re-exposure decision turns on it. A documented baseline grade also gives the toxicity side of the 0.7 efficacy weight something real to sit on. Without it, both the ranking and the screening conversation are guessing about the one toxicity this patient is most likely to already carry.
tissue_required_estimate: none; clinic examination and a questionnaire
decision_gated: Platinum or taxane re-exposure, and the grade 2 neuropathy exclusion common to trial protocols.
notes: Worth grading before the trial screening visit rather than at it, since a grade 2 finding changes which protocols are worth traveling for.

feature: Clinical course: node-negative R0 resection with early recurrence
test_name: Baseline CBC with differential, comprehensive metabolic panel with bilirubin and albumin, creatinine with calculated eGFR, coagulation studies, and CA 19-9
rationale: No laboratory values were supplied at intake, so marrow, renal, and hepatic reserve after ten cycles of chemotherapy and a pancreatic resection are entirely unknown, and these thresholds appear in the eligibility criteria of essentially every trial under consideration. A baseline CA 19-9 is also needed now if it is going to mean anything as a response measure later. Screening failures on labs that were never checked are the most avoidable way to lose weeks here.
tissue_required_estimate: one routine blood draw; can share the germline panel and ctDNA venipuncture
decision_gated: Organ-function eligibility thresholds shared by the trials under consideration, plus a baseline CA 19-9 for response assessment.

providers.name: Labcorp
providers.notes: Widest US draw-site network, which matters for a patient willing to travel for trials but drawing labs locally.

feature: Clinical course: node-negative R0 resection with early recurrence
test_name: Pancreas-protocol CT of chest, abdomen and pelvis (or MRI abdomen) defining vascular involvement, biopsy route, and local-only versus metastatic extent, with RECIST-measurable target lesions identified
rationale: The recurrence is described as a body mass with likely vascular invasion, which leaves open both whether disease is confined to the pancreatic bed and whether a measurable target lesion exists; most trials require the latter. The same scan tells the interventional team whether an EUS or percutaneous route to the mass is safe. Local-only disease also keeps radiation and locoregional options in the conversation that widely metastatic disease would close.
decision_gated: RECIST-measurable disease for trial entry, biopsy route selection, and whether locoregional options stay on the table.

feature: Homologous recombination deficiency / BRCA1 / BRCA2 pathogenic variant (germline and somatic)
test_name: Somatic homologous-recombination gene coverage (BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, RAD51 paralogs) with a genomic-instability or LOH score on the recurrence NGS
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion FFPE, or the December 2025 resection block
rationale: A germline panel will miss somatic-only BRCA and PALB2 events, which occur in pancreatic adenocarcinoma and carry the same platinum-sensitivity signal even though the olaparib label is written around germline status. A genomic-instability score adds a phenotypic read when no single gene is hit. This rides on sequencing already recommended for the recurrence, so it costs an order line rather than a new specimen.
turnaround_estimate: 2-3 weeks, concurrent with the recurrence NGS
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue beyond the recurrence NGS specimen
decision_gated: Somatic HRD evidence for off-label or trial PARP-inhibitor use and for keeping platinum in the sequence.

providers.notes: myChoice CDx is the dedicated genomic-instability assay but requires its own tissue order.

providers.notes: The whole-exome assay already recommended for the recurrence returns HR gene status and a genomic-instability read without a second specimen.

feature: CLDN18.2 expression, moderate-to-strong (2+/3+) in 60% of tumor cells
test_name: Quantified CLDN18.2 expression tier: percent of tumor cells at 1+, 2+ and 3+ membranous intensity, reported against each program's threshold
tissue_type: same slides as the CLDN18.2 re-stain
rationale: A single positive-or-negative call is useless here because the thresholds differ by program: >=75% at 2+/3+ for zolbetuximab (SPOTLIGHT, GLOW), and >=40% at >=2+ intensity for satri-cel, which the primary's 60% clears. Asking the laboratory to report the intensity distribution rather than one number lets each protocol be checked against its own criterion without re-staining. A 60% result sits in the band where this distinction decides which door is open.
turnaround_estimate: no additional time if requested with the re-stain
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue; a reporting request on the CLDN18.2 re-stain
decision_gated: Which CLDN18.2 program the expression level qualifies for: zolbetuximab-style >=75% versus CAR-T thresholds near 40%.

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
providers.assay_brand: Claudin 18 FDA (VYLOY), VENTANA CLDN18 (43-14A) RxDx Assay
providers.notes: Reports percent positivity with the FDA assay; ask explicitly for the intensity breakdown rather than the binary CDx call.

feature: Clinical course: node-negative R0 resection with early recurrence
test_name: Fecal elastase-1, fat-soluble vitamin levels (A, D, E), HbA1c, and review of biliary anatomy and stent status on the restaging scan
rationale: Exocrine insufficiency after pancreatic resection is common, under-treated, and drives the weight loss and hypoalbuminemia that later cost patients trial eligibility and dose intensity; enzyme replacement is cheap and fixes it. New endocrine insufficiency after resection is frequent enough to check for. Biliary anatomy and any indwelling stent matter because cholangitis during systemic therapy is a common reason treatment stops.
tissue_required_estimate: one stool sample plus routine blood; no procedure
decision_gated: Nutritional and hepatobiliary fitness for systemic therapy and for trial performance-status and albumin thresholds.

providers.name: Mayo Clinic Laboratories
providers.notes: Fecal elastase-1 and fat-soluble vitamin assays are catalogued send-outs run in volume.

test_name: TP53 Y220C variant allele fraction corrected for tumor purity, with TP53 copy number and LOH status, from the recurrence NGS
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion FFPE; plasma VAF as a secondary read
rationale: A Y220C reactivator only helps if the mutant protein is the dominant p53 species in most tumor cells, so a subclonal variant or a second inactivating hit on the other allele changes what the drug can plausibly do. In pancreatic adenocarcinoma TP53 alterations are typically clonal with LOH, so the expected answer supports the target rather than undercutting it. This does not gate PYNNACLE entry; it informs how much to expect.
turnaround_estimate: no additional time if requested with the recurrence NGS
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue; a reporting request on the recurrence NGS
decision_gated: Expected depth of benefit from rezatapopt; does not gate PYNNACLE eligibility.

providers.name: Caris Life Sciences
providers.assay_brand: MI Cancer Seek (whole exome plus whole transcriptome)
providers.notes: Whole-exome output reports purity, copy number, and allele fraction together, which a targeted panel often does not.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.address: 600 West Chicago Avenue, Suite 510, Chicago, IL 60654

test_name: Serial plasma ctDNA TP53 sequencing during rezatapopt treatment to detect acquired secondary TP53 alterations in cis
tissue_type: peripheral blood at baseline and at progression
rationale: Acquired secondary TP53 mutations arising in cis with Y220C drive clinical resistance to the Y220C reactivator (PMID 41504628, with accompanying commentary PMID 41918356), and they are detectable in plasma before imaging turns. Knowing that resistance is on-target rather than target-independent changes whether a next-generation p53 reactivator is worth pursuing. Only relevant once rezatapopt is actually started, which is why this sits below the eligibility rows.
decision_gated: Whether progression on rezatapopt is on-target resistance, which governs pursuit of next-generation p53 reactivators.

providers.name: Guardant Health
providers.notes: Fast repeat-draw workflow suits serial monitoring better than a tissue-anchored assay.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.address: 600 West Chicago Avenue, Suite 510, Chicago, IL 60654

test_name: Co-alteration profiling on the recurrence NGS: CDKN2A, SMAD4, ARID1A, MYC amplification, and KRAS allelic imbalance or amplification
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion FFPE, or plasma if tissue is unavailable
rationale: KRAS allelic imbalance and amplification are among the mechanisms that blunt RAS-pathway inhibition, and SMAD4 loss carries a distinct metastatic phenotype in pancreatic adenocarcinoma that bears on how aggressively to sequence therapies. None of these findings would exclude a pan-RAS(ON) trial, so this refines expectation rather than eligibility. It reads out on sequencing already ordered.
turnaround_estimate: no additional time if requested with the recurrence NGS
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue; included in the recurrence NGS report
decision_gated: Expected durability of pan-RAS(ON) inhibition; does not gate enrollment.

providers.name: Caris Life Sciences
providers.assay_brand: MI Cancer Seek (whole exome plus whole transcriptome)
providers.notes: Copy-number and allelic-imbalance calls come with the exome-based report already recommended.

providers.name: Tempus AI
providers.address: 600 West Chicago Avenue, Suite 510, Chicago, IL 60654

test_name: MMR IHC (MLH1, PMS2, MSH2, MSH6) plus MSI and TMB re-read as part of the recurrence NGS; no standalone order
tissue_type: recurrent-lesion FFPE if a biopsy is obtained
rationale: MSS status and a TMB of 0.83 mut/Mb against a threshold of 10 are already at decision resolution and close the tumor-agnostic pembrolizumab routes; nothing here needs a new order. The only caveat is that neither assay platform was named, and TMB from a small panel is not interchangeable across platforms, a caveat that bites near the cutoff rather than an order of magnitude below it. If the recurrence is biopsied and sequenced anyway, both values re-report at no extra cost and MMR IHC can ride on the same block.
turnaround_estimate: no additional time; reports with the recurrence NGS
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue; one unstained slide set if MMR IHC is added to an existing block
decision_gated: Keeps the single-agent PD-1 route closed; no new decision hinges on repeating it.

providers.name: NeoGenomics Laboratories
providers.assay_brand: Claudin 18 FDA (VYLOY), VENTANA CLDN18 (43-14A) RxDx Assay
providers.notes: MMR IHC is a routine catalogue item; only worth adding when a block is already being cut.

test_name: Characterization of KMT2C p.S2816fs as truncating and biallelic: variant allele fraction with tumor purity, KMT2C copy number and LOH, from the recurrence NGS
rationale: To be plain about it: no assay result would make this variant actionable today, because no approved or late-phase therapy selects patients on KMT2C status and the synthetic-lethal hypotheses remain preclinical. What a biallelic, clonal loss-of-function call would buy is entry to an epigenetic-agent basket trial that accepts COMPASS-complex alterations, if one is open and taking pancreatic patients. Nothing about this justifies a separate order or a separate specimen.
turnaround_estimate: no additional time; reports with the recurrence NGS
tissue_required_estimate: no additional tissue; a reporting detail on the recurrence NGS
decision_gated: Basket-trial screening on COMPASS-complex alterations; nothing approved turns on it.
notes: Carried because the user asked that every variant stay on the table, not because the evidence supports it. If the trial_screener finds no open epigenetic basket accepting pancreatic adenocarcinoma, this row has no downstream consequence.
